title: POP Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for Point operators, covering POP dimensions, point/primitive/vertex attribute sets, changed-attribute sets, template/compare flags, bounds, and inherited OP behavior.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python needs to inspect current POP geometry metadata or reason about point, primitive, and vertex attribute sets.
Use dimension for POP shape context and pointAttributes/primAttributes/vertAttributes for attribute-aware planning.
Use the changed-attribute sets to reason about what a POP modified when validating generated POP pipelines.
Use bounds(delayed=True) or computeBounds(..., delayed=True) when avoiding immediate GPU stalls matters.
Pair this class reference with Learning About POPs for broader POP data-shape concepts and rendering workflows.
